post.description: Hashes the password (bcrypt cost 12) and optionally assigns role slugs in the same transaction. Cannot create a user in another school — `school_id` is taken from the caller.

get.description: Paginated and school-scoped. Soft-deleted users are excluded. Filters: `search` (substring on name/email), `role` (slug), `status`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Substring match against name or email.

get.description: Cross-school requests return 404, never 403, so user IDs are not enumerable across tenants.
get.summary: Get one user by id (principal, vice_principal)

patch.description: Cannot change email, school_id, or roles. Switching status to `inactive`/`suspended` bumps the user's `tokenVersion` and revokes every active refresh token (BR-USR-07).

delete.description: Sets `deleted_at`, bumps `tokenVersion`, and revokes every active refresh token. The principal cannot delete their own account.

post.description: Idempotent — assigning a role the user already holds is a no-op. The actor is recorded in user_roles.assigned_by.

404.description: User not found

post.summary: Assign a role to a user (principal only)

404.description: User or role mapping not found

delete.summary: Remove a role from a user (principal only)

post.description: Hashes the supplied password with bcrypt cost 12, bumps `tokenVersion`, and revokes every active refresh token for the target user (`admin_action`).
post.summary: Reset another user's password (principal only) — BR-USR-05

get.description: Returns the seeded role catalog. Used by the user-management UI to populate role pickers and by anywhere that needs to map between numeric ids and slugs.

post.description: Supply exactly one of `email` or `id_number` together with `password`. On success, returns an access token and the user view, and sets the `refresh_token` cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=`/auth`). All failure paths — bad password, unknown identifier, inactive account, rate-limited, lockout — return the same `401 Invalid credentials` shape.
post.summary: Log in with email or national ID, plus password

post.description: Reads the `refresh_token` cookie. Replaying a rotated/revoked token revokes the entire token family and returns 401 (BR-AUTH-07).

401.description: Missing, expired, or revoked refresh cookie

post.summary: Rotate the refresh cookie and mint a new access token

post.description: Idempotent — clears the cookie either way and never reveals whether the token was valid.
Kills every device session for the authenticated user. Existing access tokens still work until they expire (15 min); see BR-USR-07 for cut-on-next-request via `tokenVersion`.
post.summary: Revoke every refresh token for the caller

post.description: Always returns 200 with the same message regardless of whether the email exists — never reveals membership. The reset token is one-time, valid for 1 hour.

get.description: Read-only — does not consume the token, bump tokenVersion, or revoke anything. Used by the reset-password page to render the email and gate the form.
get.summary: Check whether a reset token is currently usable

get.description: Authorization is role-based — the response carries a flat `roles` slug array and intentionally no `permissions` field.

post.description: `password` and `password_confirmation` must match (validated before any DB work). On success: bumps `tokenVersion`, revokes every active refresh token (`password_change`), and marks the reset token used.
post.summary: Consume a reset token and set a new password

post.description: Verifies the current password before applying. Revokes every other refresh token for the user (`password_change`); the caller's current refresh cookie keeps working so the active session is preserved. Mounted under `/auth` so the cookie (Path=`/api/auth`) is in scope.

get.description: Returns one entry per active refresh token. The entry for the device that owns the current cookie is flagged with `current: true`.
get.summary: List active sessions for the caller

delete.description: Revokes the refresh token row identified by `id` if and only if it belongs to the caller. Cross-user requests return 404, never 403, so token IDs are not enumerable.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Refresh token row id (BIGINT as string)

404.description: Session not found or not owned by caller

patch.description: Whitelist enforced via DTO + global `forbidNonWhitelisted` — sending `email`, `school_id`, `status`, or `roles` returns 400 (BR-USR-06).

post.description: Creates a new halaqa in the caller's school. Optionally assigns a primary (main) teacher and initial weekly schedule in the same transaction. Runs a schedule conflict check (BR-HLQ-02) if both primary_teacher_user_id and schedule slots are provided.

404.description: primary_teacher_user_id not found in this school

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of halaqat visible to the caller.
- **principal / vice_principal**: all halaqat in the school.
- **supervisor**: only halaqat they supervise.
- **teacher**: only halaqat where they have an active assignment.
- **parent**: no access (403).

parameters.name: supervisor_user_id
parameters.description: Filter to halaqat supervised by this user.

parameters.name: teacher_user_id
parameters.description: Filter to halaqat where this teacher has an active assignment.

get.description: Returns the full halaqa record with schedule, active teachers, supervisors, and student count. Out-of-scope or cross-school access returns 404 (never 403) per BR-HLQ-01.

404.description: Not found or out of scope

patch.description: Updates name, type, and/or evaluation_settings. Changing type requires principal/vice_principal; all other fields accept supervisor or active teacher. Status changes go through /archive, /complete, or /restore instead.

404.description: Not found or out of scope

post.description: Sets status=archived, deleted_at=now. Ends all active teacher assignments and sets active student enrollments to archived. Refuses if any student is status=active (BR-HLQ-10).

409.description: Has active students, or already archived

post.description: Sets status=completed. Ends all active teacher assignments and marks active student enrollments as completed.
Sets status=active, clears deleted_at. Only works on archived halaqat. Does not restore teacher assignments or student enrollments.

404.description: Not found or not archived

post.description: Creates an active assignment for the teacher. Role must be main or assistant — use the acting-substitute endpoint for substitutes. Runs schedule conflict check (BR-HLQ-02).

404.description: Halaqa or teacher not found in school

post.summary: Assign a teacher to a halaqa

get.description: Returns all active (end_date IS NULL) assignments for the halaqa, acting teacher first.

404.description: Not found or out of scope

patch.description: Updates role (main ↔ assistant only — cannot change substitute) and/or notes. Logs teacher_role_changed when the role actually changes.

404.description: Halaqa or assignment not found

409.description: Assignment already ended or role is substitute

post.description: Sets end_date and end_reason. Clears acting_as_primary if the teacher was acting. end_date must be >= the assignment start_date.

404.description: Halaqa or assignment not found

post.description: Marks an active assignment as acting. If acting_starts_at is today, acting_as_primary is set immediately; if future, a cron job flips it. Only one acting teacher per halaqa at a time.

404.description: Halaqa or assignment not found

409.description: Assignment ended, already acting, or another acting teacher exists

post.summary: Set an existing teacher as acting primary (Workflow A)

post.description: Brings in a teacher not yet assigned to this halaqa as an immediate acting primary. acting_starts_at must be <= today. Bypasses schedule conflict check (BR-HLQ-08).

404.description: Halaqa or teacher not found in school

409.description: Teacher already assigned or another acting teacher exists

post.summary: Assign a substitute acting teacher (Workflow B)

patch.description: Pushes acting_ends_at to a later date. New date must be after the current acting_ends_at.

400.description: New date is not after current acting_ends_at

404.description: Halaqa not found or no active acting teacher

post.description: Clears acting fields on the current acting teacher. If the teacher is a substitute, also ends the assignment row (end_reason = reassigned).

404.description: Halaqa not found or no active acting teacher

post.description: Creates an active enrollment. If the student was previously removed, updates the existing row and logs student_re_enrolled. Halaqa must be active.

404.description: Halaqa or student not found in school

409.description: Already enrolled or halaqa not active

post.summary: Enroll a student in a halaqa

get.description: Returns all students with status=active, ordered by name.

404.description: Halaqa not found or out of scope

get.summary: List active students in a halaqa

post.description: Sets the enrollment status to 'completed' or 'archived' (unenrolled). Student must be actively enrolled.

404.description: Halaqa not found or student not actively enrolled

post.summary: Remove a student from a halaqa

post.description: Atomically marks the source enrollment as transferred and creates an active enrollment in the destination halaqa. Both halaqat must be active and in the same school.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Not used — from_halaqa_id and to_halaqa_id come from the body

404.description: Halaqa or student not found or student not enrolled in source

409.description: Halaqa not active or student already in destination

post.description: User must hold the supervisor role in this school. Duplicate assignments are rejected.

404.description: Halaqa or supervisor not found in school

post.summary: Assign a supervisor to a halaqa

404.description: Halaqa not found or out of scope

get.summary: List supervisors assigned to a halaqa

404.description: Halaqa or assignment not found

delete.summary: Unassign a supervisor from a halaqa

get.description: Admins can query any user. Teachers may only query themselves (returns 403 otherwise).

404.description: User not found in this school

get.summary: List a teacher's active halaqa assignments

get.description: Admins can query any user. Supervisors may only query themselves (returns 403 otherwise).

404.description: User not found in this school

get.description: Returns all enrollment records (all statuses) for the student, newest first.

404.description: Student not found in this school

get.description: Returns a paginated, newest-first log of all events on this halaqa. Supports filtering by action type and date range.

404.description: Halaqa not found or out of scope

get.summary: List activity log entries for a halaqa

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of students visible to the caller. Scope rules per role:
- **principal / vice_principal**: all active students in the school.
- **supervisor**: students in halaqat the supervisor oversees.
- **teacher**: students in halaqat where the teacher is primary.
- **parent**: their own children across all schools (the one exception to strict school-scoping).

`include_deleted=true` is silently ignored for non-principal/VP callers. Does NOT write an audit log (read-only).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status. Omit to return all statuses.

parameters.name: halaqa_id
parameters.description: Filter by halaqa. For supervisors/teachers this is an additional scope filter on top of their role-based visibility.

parameters.name: id_number
parameters.description: Exact-match filter on national ID number (normalized before comparison).

post.description: Creates a student in the caller's school. An optional `guardians[]` array links guardians atomically in the same transaction — the first entry is forced to `is_primary=true` regardless of the submitted value. For the email-branch guardian flow, if no user exists a new account is created with the `parent` role and a parent-invite email is dispatched. Audit: `student.create` (+ `student.guardian.link` per linked guardian).

get.description: Returns the full student record including all linked guardians. Out-of-scope or cross-school access returns **404** (not 403) to avoid leaking student existence. Guardians are loaded eagerly and sorted by creation time (primary first is not guaranteed — check `is_primary`). Does NOT write an audit log.

404.description: Student not found or out of scope

get.summary: Get a student by ID (with guardians)

patch.description:
Updates an in-scope student. Caller role determines allowed fields:
- **principal / vice_principal**: all fields in `UpdateStudentDto` (bio + capacity + notes).
- **teacher**: capacity fields + `notes` only (`UpdateStudentByTeacherDto`). Teacher must be the **primary teacher** on at least one of the student's halaqat; otherwise 403. Submitting bio fields as a teacher returns 400.

Capacity values out of range (hifz 0–20, near 0–50, far 0–100) return 400. Audit: `student.update` with `oldValues`/`newValues` of changed fields only.

400.description: Validation failure or capacity out of range

403.description: Teacher not primary on any of the student's halaqat

404.description: Student not found or out of scope

delete.description: Soft-deletes the student (sets `deleted_at`). The student no longer appears in list results unless `include_deleted=true` is passed. Guardian links are preserved and can be restored. Audit: `student.delete`.

404.description: Student not found or out of scope

post.description: Clears `deleted_at` and returns the student to active status. Only applies to soft-deleted students; calling on a non-deleted student is a no-op. Audit: `student.restore`.

404.description: Student not found

post.description: Sets `status = graduated`. Does **not** soft-delete the student — the record is retained for historical reporting. Graduating an already-graduated student returns 400. `graduation_date` and `notes` are stored in the audit log `newValues` only, not on the student record. Audit: `student.graduate`.

404.description: Student not found or out of scope

get.description: Returns all guardians linked to the student, sorted by creation time (ascending). Caller must pass the `StudentScopeGuard` — out-of-scope or cross-school access returns 404. Does NOT write an audit log.

404.description: Student not found or out of scope

post.description:
Links an existing user to the student as a guardian via one of two flows:

**ID flow** (`guardian_user_id`): the user must exist in the same school. Returns 404 if not found.

**Email flow** (`email`): looks up an existing user by email in the same school. Returns 404 if not found, 409 if the account exists but is deactivated.

Both flows call `ensureRoleBySlug("parent", ...)` — idempotent, adds the role if missing.

**`is_primary` rules:**
1. First guardian on the student → forced to `is_primary=true`.
2. Subsequent guardian with `is_primary=true` → unsets the existing primary first.
3. Subsequent guardian with `is_primary=false` (or omitted) → leaves existing primary alone.

Audit: `student.guardian.link`.

400.description: Validation failure or guardian already linked

404.description: Student or guardian user not found in this school

post.summary: Link a guardian to a student (BR-STU-05)

patch.description:
Updates `relation`, `is_primary`, or `can_pickup` for an existing guardian link.

**`is_primary` rules:**
- `is_primary=true`: unsets the current primary, then sets this guardian as primary. Audit: `student.guardian.update` + implicit `student.guardian.primary_promoted` for the old primary.
- `is_primary=false`: always rejected with **400** — demoting a primary is not permitted directly. Instead, promote a different guardian.

Audit: `student.guardian.update`.

404.description: Student or guardian link not found

delete.description:
Removes the guardian link. Behaviour depends on whether the guardian is the primary:

- **Non-primary**: unlinked without side effects.
- **Primary, others remain**: earliest-created remaining guardian is auto-promoted to primary. Audit: `student.guardian.primary_promoted`.
- **Last guardian**: link removed. Audit: `student.orphaned`. A notification is dispatched to all vice_principals in the school via `NotificationService` (currently a logger stub — real delivery TBD).

Audit: `student.guardian.unlink`.

404.description: Student or guardian link not found

delete.summary: Unlink a guardian from a student (BR-STU-07)

get.description: Returns the memorized-ayat count and the base64 bitmap (780 bytes, one bit per ayah in mushaf order). Out-of-scope or cross-school access returns 404.

404.description: Student not found or out of scope

put.description: Applies `set` (mark memorized) then `clear` (unmark) ranges onto the current bitmap. **Note:** a later recompute (any Hifz achievement approve/unapprove/delete) rebuilds the bitmap from approved achievements and overwrites manual edits.

400.description: No ranges provided, or invalid verse range

404.description: Student not found or out of scope

put.summary: Manually edit a student's memorized-ayat bitmap

get.description: Aggregates the student's recitation errors by ayah over the last `days` days, returning the worst ayat (most errors first) with per-type counts. Staff only — parents do not see error breakdowns. Out-of-scope or cross-school access returns 404.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: How many days back to aggregate errors over. Defaults to 56 (8 weeks).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max number of hotspots (worst ayat) to return. Defaults to 20.

404.description: Student not found or out of scope

get.description: Returns all students for which the authenticated parent has a `student_guardians` entry. **Cross-school exception**: this is the only endpoint in the system that returns students from multiple schools. A parent's children may be enrolled at different schools, so the school-scope rule is intentionally bypassed here. Soft-deleted students are excluded. No pagination — returns all children in one response. Does NOT write an audit log.

403.description: Caller does not have the parent role

get.description: Returns the full student record including all guardians. Returns **404** if the student does not exist or the caller is not linked to the student as a guardian — never 403, to avoid leaking student existence. **Cross-school exception**: parent may access a child in a different school than their own. Does NOT write an audit log.

403.description: Caller does not have the parent role

404.description: Student not found or caller is not the student's guardian

get.summary: Get a child by ID (parent only)

post.description: Idempotent upload of an offline attendance batch. Each entry is deduped by `client_uuid` (re-syncing the same batch changes nothing), then applied to the student's (student, date) row — a pre-seeded/existing row is corrected, otherwise a new row is created. Entries the caller has no scope over are rejected individually (`forbidden`) without failing the batch. Supervisors and parents cannot record (403).

get.description:
Paginated attendance visible to the caller.
- **principal / vice_principal**: whole school.
- **supervisor**: students in supervised halaqat (read-only).
- **teacher**: students in their halaqat.
- **parent**: their own children (stripped view — no recorder/modifier fields).

patch.description: Changes the status of one attendance row, recording who changed it, why (`modification_reason`), and the value it had before the first correction (`original_status`). Out-of-scope or cross-school rows return 404.

404.description: Not found or out of scope.

post.description: Idempotent upload of a staff attendance batch (teachers + admins). Principal / vice_principal only. Same dedup-by-`client_uuid` and per-row `forbidden` semantics as student sync.

403.description: Only principal/VP can record staff attendance.

get.description: principal / vice_principal see all staff in the school; any other staff role sees only their own rows.

patch.description: Principal / vice_principal only. Records who changed it, why, and the original status.

403.description: Only principal/VP can correct staff attendance.

404.description: Not found or out of scope.

patch.summary: Correct a single staff attendance row

post.description: Declares that the school operates on `day_of_week` for the given effective window. The seed cron only creates attendance on days covered by an effective row.
post.summary: Add a school schedule row (operating weekday)

parameters.name: on
parameters.description: If given, return only schedule rows effective on this date.

404.description: Not found or out of scope.

409.description: A holiday already exists on this date.

get.summary: List holidays (optionally within a date range)

404.description: Not found or out of scope.

post.description: Records a Quran recitation achievement for a student. `percentage_score` is computed on the frontend (from raw counts and the halaqa evaluation settings) and stored as-is. Pass `approve: true` to approve in the same request — caller must have approval authority (403 if not, never silently skipped). If the student is absent the request is rejected (400).

400.description: Validation error, invalid verse range, or student absent.

403.description: No halaqa scope, or approve=true without authority.

404.description: Not found or out of scope.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of achievements visible to the caller.
- **principal / vice_principal**: all achievements in the school.
- **supervisor**: achievements for halaqat they supervise.
- **teacher**: achievements for halaqat they are assigned to.
- **parent**: achievements for their linked students only.   `recorded_by` and `approved_by` filters return 400 for this role.

parameters.name: recorded_by
parameters.description: Filter by recorder user ID. Not available for parent role (400).

parameters.name: approved_by
parameters.description: Filter by approver user ID. Not available for parent role (400).

get.description: Returns a single achievement. Out-of-scope or cross-school access returns 404 (never 403). Parent role: `mistakes_count`, `warnings_count`, `tajweed_errors_count`, `recorded_by_name`, `approved_by_name`, and `approved_at` are omitted.

404.description: Not found or out of scope.

patch.description: Updates mutable fields on an **unapproved** achievement. Returns 400 if the achievement is approved (unapprove it first). `percentage_score` is updated only when the client sends it (recomputed on the frontend). If surah/verse fields change, the range is re-validated.

400.description: Achievement is approved, or invalid verse range.

404.description: Not found or no halaqa scope.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes an achievement.
- **Unapproved**: any role with halaqa scope can delete.
- **Approved**: principal only (VP and teachers are rejected with 403).
If the deleted achievement was approved, plan item reconciliation runs automatically.

404.description: Not found or no halaqa scope.

post.description: Marks the achievement as approved. Caller must be: principal, VP, supervisor in scope, or primary/acting teacher for the halaqa. Returns 400 if already approved. Triggers plan item reconciliation.

403.description: No approval authority for this halaqa.

404.description: Not found.

post.description: Reverts an approved achievement back to unapproved. Principal and vice_principal only. `approved_by` and `approved_at` are preserved for audit purposes (status only is flipped). Returns 400 if not currently approved. Triggers plan item reconciliation.

404.description: Not found.

post.description: Placeholder — returns 501. Auto-generation strategy is undecided. Use `POST /weekly-plans` to create plans manually.

Creates a draft weekly plan with one or more items. Caller must be principal, VP, supervisor in scope, or primary/acting teacher of the halaqa. Regular (non-primary) teachers are rejected with 403. Returns 409 if a plan already exists for the same student/halaqa/week.

400.description: Validation error or invalid verse range.

403.description: No primary-teacher authority for this halaqa.

409.description: Plan already exists. Response includes existing_plan_id.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of weekly plans visible to the caller.
- **principal / vice_principal**: all plans in the school.
- **supervisor**: plans for halaqat they supervise.
- **teacher**: plans for halaqat they are assigned to.
- **parent**: plans for their linked students only.
Returns the plan with all its items. Out-of-scope or cross-school access returns 404 (never 403).

404.description: Not found or out of scope.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the plan and its items. Principal and vice_principal only. This is a hard delete — the plan and its items are removed from the database and cannot be restored.

404.description: Not found.

post.description: Locks the plan structure and runs reconciliation for every item. Caller must be principal, VP, supervisor in scope, or primary/acting teacher of the halaqa. Returns 400 if already approved.

404.description: Not found.

post.description: Reverts the plan to draft status. Principal and VP only. `approved_by` is preserved for audit purposes. Returns 400 if not currently approved.

404.description: Not found.

post.description: Adds a new item to a **draft** plan. Returns 400 if the plan is approved (unapprove it first). Caller must be principal, VP, supervisor in scope, or primary/acting teacher of the halaqa.

400.description: Plan is approved, or invalid verse range.

404.description: Plan not found.

post.summary: Add an item to a weekly plan

delete.description: Hard-deletes a plan item. Returns 400 if the plan is approved (unapprove first). Caller must have primary-teacher authority for the halaqa.

404.description: Item not found or out of scope.

patch.description: Updates a plan item's range, track type, or day. Range edits are allowed even on **approved** plans (no unapprove required). Changing any range field (`start_surah`, `start_verse`, `end_surah`, `end_verse`) sets `is_manual_override = true` permanently, recomputes `total_verses`, and re-runs reconciliation. Caller must have primary-teacher authority for the halaqa.

404.description: Item not found or out of scope.

info.title: Halaqa Backend API
info.description: Authentication, user management, and school operations for the Halaqa system. All JSON responses are wrapped in a uniform envelope: `{ "code": <http>, "data": ... }` on success, `{ "code": <http>, "message": "..." }` on errors. Refresh tokens travel as HttpOnly cookies on `/auth/*`; access tokens use Bearer auth.

tags.name: Students
tags.description: Student CRUD, soft-delete/restore, and graduation. Visibility is role-scoped.

tags.name: Guardians
tags.description: Link, update, and unlink guardians for a student.

tags.name: My Children
tags.description: Parent-only views over their linked students.

tags.name: Achievements
tags.description: Record, approve, unapprove, and delete Quran recitation achievements. Percentage score is computed automatically. Parents see a restricted view (no error counts or approval meta).

tags.name: Weekly Plans
tags.description: Create, approve, and manage weekly recitation plans for students. Approving a plan locks its items; achieved_verses and status are reconciled automatically when achievements are approved.

tags.name: Plan Items
tags.description: Add, edit, or remove individual items within a weekly plan. Editing ranges on an approved plan sets is_manual_override=1 and re-runs reconciliation.

id_number.description: National ID number (Palestinian: 9 digits). Normalized and unique per school; also usable as a login identifier. A bad checksum is stored with a warning, not rejected.

roles.description: Role slugs to assign at creation (e.g. ["teacher", "parent"]).

details.description: Validation error list (only on 400 with multiple field errors).

message.example: A reset link has been sent.

id_number.description: National ID number. Required when `email` is not provided.

rememberMe.description: When true, issues a long-lived refresh cookie (`JWT_REFRESH_TTL_DAYS`). When false or absent, the cookie is short-lived (`JWT_REFRESH_TTL_DAYS_DEFAULT`).

roles.description: Flat array of role slugs the user holds.

accessToken.description: JWT access token (HS256, 15 min). Use as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

roles.description: Flat list of role slugs. Authorization is role-based — there is no `permissions` field.

token.description: Raw token from the password-reset email link.

currentPassword.description: Current password — required to authorise the change.

current.description: True for the device that owns the cookie on the current request.

evaluation_settings.description: Per-error-type score deductions used by the frontend to compute percentage_score. Any omitted weight falls back to its default (mistake 4, warning 2, tajweed 1, harakat 2).

primary_teacher_user_id.description: Creates an active main-teacher assignment on creation.

type.description: Only principal / vice_principal may change the type.

evaluation_settings.description: Per-error-type score deductions. Replaces the stored object wholesale — send every weight you want to keep. Omitted weights fall back to their defaults; pass null to reset to defaults.

teacher_user_id.description: Must be a user in this school with the teacher role.

role.description: Use the acting-substitute endpoint to create a 'substitute' row.
Cannot switch to or from 'substitute' here — substitutes have a strict acting lifecycle.

acting_starts_at.description: >= today. If today, acting_as_primary is set immediately; if future, a cron flips it.

notes.example: Covering for sister halaqa during main's absence

teacher_user_id.description: Must be a user in this school with the teacher role, not already actively assigned here.

acting_starts_at.description: <= today. Substitutes cannot be future-dated; acting_as_primary is set to 1 immediately.

student_id.description: Must be an active student in this school.

outcome.description: 'completed' — student finished the halaqa; 'unenrolled' — dropped out or left without completing. Both set student_halaqa.status; the activity log action distinguishes them.

student_id.description: Student must be active in from_halaqa_id.

from_halaqa_id.description: Student must be currently active here.

to_halaqa_id.description: Must differ from from_halaqa_id; must be active and in the same school.

supervisor_user_id.description: Must be a user in this school with the supervisor role.

daily_hifz_pages_capacity.description: Daily Hifz memorisation target in pages (0–20).

id_number.description: National ID number. Always present when you can see the student. Value is null for legacy students created before this field was required.

is_primary.description: Exactly one guardian per student has this set.

daily_hifz_pages_capacity.description: Daily Hifz memorisation target in pages (0–20).

id_number.description: National ID number. Always present when you can see the student. Value is null for legacy students created before this field was required.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings. Present only when id_number validation produced warnings.

guardian_user_id.description: ID of an existing user. Mutually exclusive with `email`. Must belong to the same school.

email.description: Email of an existing user. Mutually exclusive with `guardian_user_id`. Returns 404 if not found.

is_primary.description: Exactly one guardian per student may be primary. If omitted on the first guardian, forced to true. Setting true unsets the current primary. Setting false on the current primary is rejected (400).

can_pickup.description: Whether the guardian is authorised to pick up the student. Defaults to true.

daily_hifz_pages_capacity.description: Daily Hifz memorisation target in pages. Defaults to 0.5.

daily_near_pages_capacity.description: Daily near-review target in pages. Defaults to 2.

daily_far_pages_capacity.description: Daily far-review target in pages. Defaults to 5.

id_number.description: National ID number. Format is country-specific (Palestinian: 9 digits). A bad checksum is stored with a warning, not rejected. Unique per school (soft-deleted rows included in the constraint).

guardians.description: Guardians linked atomically in the same transaction. First entry is forced to is_primary=true.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings. Present only when id_number validation produced warnings.

status.description: Use POST /students/:id/graduate to set graduated; this field accepts any status for admin overrides.

id_number.description: National ID number. Set to null to clear a previously-set value (requires force_id_number_change: true). Changing an already-set value also requires the flag. A bad checksum is stored with a warning in the response.

force_id_number_change.description: Required when changing or clearing an already-set id_number. Transient — never persisted.

graduation_date.description: Recorded in the audit log; does not update the student record directly.

is_primary.description: Set to true to promote this guardian to primary (unsets the current primary). Setting false is rejected with 400 — use another guardian's PATCH with is_primary=true instead.

bitmap_base64.description: Base64 of the 780-byte bitmap. Bit i (MSB-first per byte) = the i-th ayah in mushaf order, starting at Al-Fatihah:1 (index 0).

total.description: Total errors at this ayah in the window.

days.description: The window (in days) that was aggregated.

total_errors.description: Total error occurrences across all ayat in the window.

hotspots.description: Worst ayat, most errors first (ties broken by mushaf order).

client_uuid.description: Client-generated id used for idempotent re-sync.

client_recorded_at.description: When the record was captured on the device.

duplicate.description: Already applied on a previous sync.

forbidden.description: Actor lacks scope over the student.

modification_reason.example: Marked present by mistake in the morning.

start_word_id.description: QUL word id (sequential in mushaf order).

errors.description: Errors made at this position. Each must fall within the position range. Omit or send [] for a clean position. The per-type counts are derived from this list.

student_id.description: Student ID. Must belong to the caller's school.

halaqa_id.description: Halaqa ID. Caller must have scope on this halaqa.

completion_method.description: How the achievement was entered. Defaults to `quick`.

recitation_method.description: How it was recited. `full` auto-creates one position spanning the whole range. `test` requires `test_positions` (each within the achievement range). Defaults to `full`.

test_positions.description: Required (>=1) when `recitation_method = test`. Rejected for `full`. Each position must fall within the achievement range and carries its own error counts; the achievement-level counts are their sum.

errors.description: Errors for `recitation_method = full` only — they attach to the single auto-created position. Rejected for `test` (send errors inside each `test_positions` entry). Each error must fall within the achievement range. The per-type counts are derived from this list.

percentage_score.description: Computed on the frontend from raw counts and the halaqa evaluation settings. Stored as-is.

approve.description: Approve in the same request. Caller must have approval authority. Lacks authority → 403 (never silently downgraded to unapproved).

mistakes_count.description: Derived from `errors`. Hidden for parent role.

warnings_count.description: Derived from `errors`. Hidden for parent role.

tajweed_errors_count.description: Derived from `errors`. Hidden for parent role.

harakat_errors_count.description: Harakat (حركات) errors, derived from `errors`. Hidden for parent role.

errors.description: Itemized errors at this position. Hidden for parent role.

recitation_positions.description: Recited/tested positions. One full-range row for `full`; one per tested position for `test`.

harakat_errors_count.description: Total harakat (حركات) errors across all positions. Hidden for parent role.

recitation_method.description: Changing to `full` replaces positions with one full-range row. Changing to `test` requires `test_positions`.

test_positions.description: Replaces the achievement's positions. Required when setting `recitation_method = test`.

errors.description: Errors for `recitation_method = full` only — replaces the single position's errors and the derived totals. Rejected for `test` (resend `test_positions` with their errors instead).

order.description: Reconciliation priority within the same day + track (lower = first). Defaults to 0.

student_id.description: Student ID. Must belong to the caller's school.

halaqa_id.description: Halaqa ID. Caller must have primary-teacher authority.

order.description: Reconciliation priority within the same day + track (lower = first).

is_manual_override.description: True if range was edited after item creation.
